fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on a $50,000 libel suit and arrest involving Justice of the Peace Penney and Miami Life editor Wen R. Phillips; criticism of Dade County commissioners’ handling of county deposits and proposed bond spending; discussion of post-hurricane rebuilding and civic improvements across Greater Miami; coverage of worsening transportation service under Florida Power and Light Company; notes on a doctors’ registry dispute involving the Dade County Medical Association and Adele Hampton; and extensive sports/entertainment items including promotion of the Tunney–Dempsey fight returns by radio at Biscayne Fronton, plus columns, humor, and local “Miami-grams.”
